about: The collecta of the formulary “Easter Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, who today, through Thine Only-begotten, didst unlock for us the entrance to eternity, death being conquered: our prayers, which by going before them Thou dost inspire, do Thou also follow with Thy help. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
